description: Spread and drain w/o the hassle of ambushes!
strategy:
I love using bounty hunters and running amok and CCT wasnt cutting it for me. I like this objective because it beefs up force drains and makes characters capable of soloing on a large scale.

IT-O and Interrogation Room with expand the empire boosts force drains even while dark deal isnt out and makes it that much worse once it is when the bounty hunters are escorting captives.

When bounty hunters dont cut it, maul plays backup slash-and-hack to thin out opponents ranks and when forfeit has been reduced to 0, Human shield assists and doesnt allow your opponent to get their captives back alive. Make sure to setup the obsidians on cloud city to beef up power that much more

Defensive fire [V], ng'ok, and Res Luk Ra'auf helps anti ambushes which is an asset in spread-and-drain scenarios.

I still need cloud city occupation and might try to switch out weather vane for im sorry, but i need them first.

Anyhoo, thats pretty much all i can think of. Leave a comment and help me out a bit, eh?
